chars.GIRL: a Moroccan young woman of 19 with long dark wavy hair, wearing a lilac zip-up tracksuit jacket over a white top and light blue wide-leg jeans
chars.INFLUENCER: a Moroccan man around 30 with a trimmed black beard and slicked-back hair, wearing a cream oversized hoodie with a thin gold chain, black ripped jeans and white sneakers
chars.DIRECTOR: a Moroccan man in his late 40s with short grey hair and thin rectangular glasses, wearing a navy blazer over a white open-collar shirt

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the open bedroom doorway: GIRL sits cross-legged on her bed in a modest Moroccan apartment bedroom in Casablanca, mid-act staring at her phone with wide eyes and her hand over her open mouth in surprised disbelief, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, morning light. Phone screen glows, no readable text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: GIRL jumps up on her bed holding her phone to her chest, huge excited smile, eyes closed in joy, colourful Moroccan blanket and cushions, comic energy, medium shot, face visible.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Daydream: GIRL posing confidently in front of a big studio camera and softbox lights, one hand on her hip, playful proud smile, studio with white backdrop, slightly dreamy glow at the edges, full figure centred.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: GIRL sits at a small desk in her bedroom in front of an open laptop, typing a reply, biting her lip nervously but excited, a glass of mint tea next to the laptop, warm afternoon light, three-quarter view, face visible. Laptop screen shows only abstract shapes, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: GIRL filming herself with a phone on a small tripod ring light in her bedroom, talking animatedly to the camera with expressive hand gestures, slightly rushed messy hair, medium shot, face visible.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Over-the-shoulder view from behind GIRL at her desk: on the laptop screen in a video call, DIRECTOR sits in a modern glass office smiling professionally; GIRL's face is visible in a small mirror reflection-free three-quarter angle, sitting up straight trying to look serious. No text on screen.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: GIRL at her desk leans toward the laptop, squinting and puzzled, as a second video window shows INFLUENCER in a stylish loft waving with a big confident grin; she clearly does not recognise him. Side view of GIRL, both faces visible. No text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Imagined advert set: INFLUENCER speaks into a studio microphone pointing at the camera like a host while GIRL stands next to him smiling a bit awkwardly holding a product box, bright colourful set, medium-wide shot, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of GIRL at her desk in front of the laptop, leaning in with raised eyebrows and a held breath, fingers crossed under her chin, suspenseful moment waiting for a number, warm lamp light, face visible.
